name: Steamed rice rolls
summary: The provincial tourism portal, 9 June 2021, describes a town plate of bánh ướt with a yellow, glossy, sweet fish sauce, plus thịt ram, chả lụa, fried pork cake, and nem chua, in whatever mix you want. The article calls the sauce the soul of that plate and says it is not made the same way elsewhere. A price is check on arrival.
origin: Town, on the provincial tourism portal’s 9 June 2021 article.
taste: The portal calls the fish sauce yellow, glossy, sweet, and aromatic. That description is that plate’s sauce.
howToEat: Take the rolls with the sauce, and add thịt ram, chả lụa, fried pork cake, or nem chua. The article does not print a wrapper recipe.
A stall price was not printed. The price is check on arrival.
where: Town. An opening hour was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Banh uot in Ben Tre — sweet yellow fish sauce
seoDescription: Ben Tre bánh ướt comes with a yellow sweet fish sauce, thịt ram, chả lụa, fried pork cake, and nem chua. The price is check on arrival.
